note: Shows when you click the i next to "Solver".

text: The solver decides the puzzle by finding the correct state for every edge (link or wall). Either by deduction logic, by going neighbors to neighbors, or by testing links between far away symbols. The global idea being that a puzzle solvable by deduction would have a breakthrough spot. The solver is designed to find it by attacking the puzzle with those approaches.
note: Shows when you click the i next to "Solver".

text: If it can't find a breakthrough in the current puzzle state, the solver skips to a final solve and does an exhaustive search on the half done puzzle, hopefully finding an impossibility or a solution. If the solver has trouble finding a solution after a minute of exhaustive search, the puzzle probably requires a global thinking that the solver can’t find. If that is the case, please send your puzzle to me! (nittneuk on discord) so I can try to implement a reasoning for puzzle of it's kind.

text: #!/bin/sh # Glimmith solver: one-click import setup (Linux). # Makes the folder "Glimmith puzzles" next to this file, with two links (symbolic links) to the game's puzzle folders: # downloaded = the puzzles you downloaded from the Steam workshop, made = the puzzles you made. # Nothing is copied or moved. Deleting "Glimmith puzzles" deletes only the links. Run it with: sh glimmith-setup.sh # If Steam is somewhere else, put its folder first in the STEAMS line. STEAMS="$HOME/.local/share/Steam $HOME/.steam/steam $HOME/.var/app/com.valvesoftware.Steam/.local/share/Steam" APP=4160210 DEST="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)/Glimmith puzzles" mkdir -p "$DEST" link(){ # name, list of places: the first that exists name="$1"; shift if [ -e "$DEST/$name" ]; then echo "Already there: $DEST/$name"; return; fi for p in "$@"; do if [ -d "$p" ]; then ln -s "$p" "$DEST/$name" && echo "Linked $name -> $p"; return; fi; done echo "Not found: the $name puzzles (looked in: $*)" } W=""; O="" for s in $STEAMS; do W="$W $s/steamapps/workshop/content/$APP" O="$O $s/steamapps/compatdata/$APP/pfx/drive_c/users/steamuser/AppData/Local/Geri/Saved/workshop" done link downloaded $W link made $O echo echo "Done. In the Glimmith solver, choose this folder once: $DEST"
